Downloadable file attached to the ORA eTraining module "Building the Project Team: Contractual Hiring and Compensation", lesson "Electronic Personnel Action Forms (EPAF)".
Source: https://articulateusercontent.com/rise/courses/yeGd83XB_frmwl2TaIRYWkWJUavnQ7cV/eaowziNOe58a9TFH-Position%2520Description%2520Form%2520(Blank%2520Copy).docx

Instructions: List the education, experience, and licensure required to perform the duties of the role. Also list any special conditions or requirements of this position (e.g., being subject to pre-employment and/or random drug testing, mandatory shift rotations, unscheduled overtime, on-call shifts, or travel).
Ensure that the minimum qualifications (required elements) are what is actually necessary to perform the job adequately, and that all requirements can be supported by the duties and tasks described in Section III. Inflated education and experience requirements needlessly restrict applicant pools, and tend to disproportionately screen out women, people of color, and qualified individuals with disabilities. For classified positions, all requirements in this section must exactly match those set forth in the applicable classification specification—see MSU Job Specifications. This information is also used for the job advertisement if the position is being posted.

EXPERIENCE (For Classified Positions – Refer to MSU Job Specifications)
